_note: Curated via CURATION_PROMPT.md (curate-classic-gear). Mage is a pure Intellect/Spirit CLOTH caster; all 3 specs (Arcane/Fire/Frost) share ONE gear profile (the engine scores only Str/Agi/Int/Sta/Spi -- fire/frost school damage is not scored, so no spec-specific armor split is possible or honest). Every id verified MATCH (quality>=2, id<200000) and every armor piece stat-validated for real Int/Spirit/Stamina. Weapons are caster staves/wands/daggers carrying Int/Spirit (physical DPS weapons are hidden for a caster by IsOffSpec). No mage race/faction-locked items and no weapon-skill racial display effect, so all 4 races (Human/Gnome/Undead/Troll) get identical copies. Genuine Era gaps: bands 1-10 (no fixed-id stat-bearing caster cloth or uncommon+ caster weapon that low) and 41-50 weapons (no Int/Spirit caster weapon in that bracket -- mages ride Staff of Jordan, RLvl 35, until Wand of Eternal Light at 52) are intentionally thin/empty. No Classic Era caster trinket carries a scored primary (all spell-power/use-effect only), so the trinket slot is empty in the leveling pool. bis = level-60 raid epics (MC/BWL/ZG/AQ/Naxx), shared by all 3 specs, sourced separately from the leveling pool.
